answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake into a reputation bond before trading: the bond grows with verified work and shrinks on proven abuse, so one operator running a hundred clones must fund a hundred bonds. Like onyx, the stake is hard to fake; honest agents stand on a ledge of earned history while clones slide off, and an ivory-tower identity check is replaced by skin in the game that makes fake identities expensive instead of free.
